gates.summary: Compiler built without collector (-Dgc_none), 81 sample builds across 3 runs with 0 failures, string constructor terminator room verified at 3000 lengths, 30-module project built 3 times with 0 failures, bdw-gc unreachability verified, default build restored (.build/iyi, .build/crystal, .build/iyi-daemon).
Symbols and libraries checked for plain and release builds; libgc opt-in verified; dladdr and dprintf approved on Darwin; the floor holds.
External build-time and runtime tool dependency audit verified; the tool floor holds.
Concurrency runtime verified; stdin parking and cancellation verified; deadlock diagnosis and failure proofs held; concurrency gate: every step held.
Parallel tasks across workers, migration across worker threads, loop back-edge preemption, tight loop costs, speedup measured; every property held.
200 connections answered, collections while parked, stack reuse verified, failure proofs held; server load: every step held.
Panics, unwinding, defers, task boundaries, exit statuses, cast failures, failure proofs, backtraces verified; panics gate: every step held.
Thread floor on Darwin libSystem, stop-the-world pause measurements across thread counts, thread-local storage, failure proofs; thread floor: every step held.
Kernel threads under collector, 8 and 32 threads, allocations per thread, stop-the-world, Share safety checks and failure proofs; thread exercise: every step held.
Parallel marker alone and with helpers, permit distribution, failure proofs; parallel mark: every step held.
Concurrent marker with write barrier, realloc buffers, assists, failure proofs; concurrent mark: every step held.
Size-class arena allocator, size classes, addressability, clearing, reuse, traversal, large mappings, allocation floor; the arena allocator holds.
Stack, register, global roots discovery, interior pointer resolution, maps parser, failure proofs; Roots: stack, registers and globals are all found.
Mark phase traversal, cycle termination, precision, failure proofs; Marking: live set black, unreachable white, cycles terminate.
Sweep phase reclamation, warm page reuse, survivor preservation, failure proofs; Sweeping: unreachable chunks come back and are handed out again.
Chunk reuse integrity, zeroed fields on reuse, failure proofs; reuse integrity gate: every step held.
Allocation pressure trigger, bounded heap, empty arena return, failure proofs; Trigger: collections come from allocation pressure alone.
Samples compilation from source and from .iyimod artifacts with source deleted; 12 modules identical output, symbol numbering and travel defs verified.
Sockets connect, accept, message exchange, short reads, IPv6, unix sockets, timeouts, failure proofs verified; Sockets: all checks passed.
TLS throughput verified against cipher rate (AES-128-GCM pull 90%/push 83%, ChaCha20-Poly1305 pull 80%/push 65%, all above 25% floor).
crystal-metric port, all 26 benchmarks correct (26.00/26, award 1.00), failure proofs held; crystal-metric's port holds.
iyi migrate on a Crystal fixture, compilation of migrated modules, 16 lines output match, artifact emission, failure proofs; migrate gate: passed.
